briefs.heat: Forecast rectal temperature at +5/+10/+20min for unseen people using causal history of skin_c,hr_bpm,ambient_c,humidity_pct and demographics. Output forecasts with horizon_min,mean_c,lower_c,upper_c plus state. Primary: person MAE.
briefs.load: Predict gross metabolic W at 4 km/h, loads 0/5/10/15kg for unseen people. Inputs mass_kg,height_cm,age_years,load_kg. Output mean_w,lower_w,upper_w,state. Primary: person MAE.
briefs.pulse: Estimate heart rate for unseen people using trailing PPG/acceleration windows. Output mean_bpm,lower_bpm,upper_bpm,state. Primary: person MAE. ECG-derived reference labels are provisional.

function.description: Return the requested experiment or final selection.
function.name: respond

system: Develop an executable predictor in offline /work. You get two Python training experiments, then select one valid evaluated artifact. Call respond once. code must create artifact/inference.py with predict(artifact_dir,request), fitted files and requirements.lock. Use only staged public data; no network or private labels. reason is a brief evidence-based explanation, <=160 characters. You may use the provided baseline helper or write your own code. Use the supplied trial seed. Available: numpy, scipy, sklearn, joblib; pandas is unavailable. Keep code concise.
